_meta.description: Ground truth for the images in this folder. Keys follow the public output schema. Dates are ISO (YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD). null means the field is intentionally absent/unreadable and must NOT be filled by the OCR.
_meta.WARNING_DRAFT_LABELS: These labels were transcribed by an AI assistant from the two sample photos and have NOT been checked by a human. Check every value against the physical card, then set labels_verified to true. Until then all accuracy numbers are PROVISIONAL.
_meta.WARNING_PII: This file contains the identity data printed on the sample card. Do not commit it to a public repository.
_meta.how_to_add_images: Copy the image into this folder, add an entry to 'samples' with front/back file names and the *_truth objects. Only include fields you have verified by eye; omit a key to exclude it from scoring.
